professionalSummary.text: Four years as Shift Operations Supervisor at a bottling plant with three high-speed lines, managing crew allocation, briefings, stoppage resolution, and shift documentation under established procedures.
professionalSummary.witness: Shift operations supervisor at a bottling plant with three high-speed lines for four years, allocating a crew of seventeen across the lines each shift under the plant's crewing plan.

experienceHighlights.text: Allocated a crew of seventeen across three high-speed lines each shift under the plant's crewing plan for four years.
experienceHighlights.witness: Shift operations supervisor at a bottling plant with three high-speed lines for four years, allocating a crew of seventeen across the lines each shift under the plant's crewing plan.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran shift start and hand-over briefings under the plant's briefing standard, with records signed by crew leads and audited monthly by the production manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the shift start and hand-over briefings under the plant's briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the crew leads each shift and audited monthly by the production manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Resolved line stoppages with the shift maintenance technician under the stoppage procedure, with each stoppage and resolution logged in the line system.
experienceHighlights.witness: Resolved the line stoppages with the shift maintenance technician under the stoppage procedure, with each stoppage and its resolution logged in the line system.

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded shift output and downtime in the line system each shift, with line speed and changeover decisions documented as the production manager's responsibility.
experienceHighlights.witness: Recorded the shift's output and downtime in the line system each shift; line speed and changeover decisions were the production manager's, recorded against my shift record.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented shift open items and hand-over conditions on the hand-over sheet for the next supervisor.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the shift's open items and hand-over conditions on the hand-over sheet for the next supervisor.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a week's briefing records with crew leads' signatures, stoppage log, and hand-over sheet, with line system references as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one week's briefing records with the crew leads' signatures, the stoppage log for the same week and one hand-over sheet, with the line system references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Operational leadership in managing shift crews, resolving stoppages, and documenting shift activities in a bottling plant environment.
skills.witness: Shift operations supervisor at a bottling plant with three high-speed lines for four years, allocating a crew of seventeen across the lines each shift under the plant's crewing plan.

decisionBoundary.statement: All requirements are supported by evidence, but human review is required to assess leadership depth and unexpected disruption handling.

evidence.text: Shift operations supervisor at a bottling plant with three high-speed lines for four years, allocating a crew of seventeen across the lines each shift under the plant's crewing plan.
Ran the shift start and hand-over briefings under the plant's briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the crew leads each shift and audited monthly by the production manager.

Interviewer 2 note: asked to run a shift-start briefing for the panel, the candidate covered the line allocation, the two safety notices, the changeover time and the target for each line in that order, asked each crew lead by name to confirm their allocation, and finished inside the five minutes the standard allows.
Resolved the line stoppages with the shift maintenance technician under the stoppage procedure, with each stoppage and its resolution logged in the line system.
Recorded the shift's output and downtime in the line system each shift; line speed and changeover decisions were the production manager's, recorded against my shift record.
Wrote the shift's open items and hand-over conditions on the hand-over sheet for the next supervisor.
Work sample: one week's briefing records with the crew leads' signatures, the stoppage log for the same week and one hand-over sheet, with the line system references as a verification trail.
